# HH-002D: Review the 360px mobile experience and accessibility (read-only)

**OBJECTIVE:** Find problems that would hurt use on a 360px-wide Android phone, by reading the code.

**CONTEXT:** Mobile-first local skills app. Requirements: no horizontal scrolling at 360px, large touch targets (at least 44px), short forms, explicit loading/empty/error states, and a half-written form must survive a lost connection.

**SCOPE:** Read-only. You may read only src/app/globals.css, src/components/*.tsx and src/app/**/page.tsx. Do not read anything else.

**CONSTRAINTS:** Do not edit any file except reports/HH-002D.md. Do not read .env.local. Do not install packages or use the network. Do not propose new features.

**ACCEPTANCE:** At most 6 findings, each with: file and line, the problem, who it affects, and a small fix. Mark anything you could not verify from the code alone.

**EVIDENCE:** reports/HH-002D.md, under 100 lines.

**STOP:** Stop after writing the report.
